value.rationale: The source asks how limited attention and recommender mediation influence disinformation outbreaks; the complete exact local-ignition phase boundary alpha=tau-2 and cutoff exponents address this precise gap. The strict degree-cutoff reversal exposes a finite-appeal effect hidden by a first-order approximation, and a physically admissible leakage threshold demonstrates how independent channel screening can miss joint activation. All concern the same motivated local frontier, not an arbitrary numerical slice; relevance to real platforms remains unproved.
